notes.title: 🌊⚓ Plus Ultra: Legado – Launch Date Revealed! ⚓🌊
notes.content:
[p]We’re thrilled to announce that [b]Plus Ultra: Legado[/b] will officially set sail on [b]October 9th, 2025[/b]! [/p][p]🗓️ [b]Release Date:[/b] October 9th, 2025
⚔️ [b]Your legacy begins soon…[/b][/p][p]Mark your calendars—the journey is almost here. Soon, you’ll be able to dive into an adventure of discovery, strategy, and legacy-building where every choice you make will shape your story across uncharted seas.[/p][p]Until launch day, we’ll be sharing more gameplay details, behind-the-scenes insights, and previews of what awaits you. Stay tuned to this page and make sure to [b]wishlist and follow[/b] so you don’t miss any updates![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2685570/Plus_Ultra_Legado/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: 🎉 Plus Ultra: Legado demo is now available! 🎮
notes.content:
The time has come: embark on the adventure!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3650930/

We’re thrilled to announce that the free demo of Plus Ultra: Legacy is now available on Steam. This is your chance to step into the world of our historical metroidvania, where the past comes alive and every decision matters.

🛡️ Experience the opening chapter of the story
⚔️ Meet key characters and face your first challenges
🗺️ Discover a unique setting inspired by the legacy of the Empire

Your journey is just beginning. Are you ready to forge your legacy?

👉 Download the demo now and share your thoughts with the community. Your feedback is essential to the development of the full game!

notes.title: WE MADE IT!
notes.content:
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/pontica/plus-ultra-legado-a-comic-style-historical-metroidvania?ref=8whf3e][img]https://i.imgur.com/yWBdmeo.png[/img][/url]

[u][b]WE MADE IT![/b][/u]

We managed to fund the game in 10 days! And there're [b]20 other days ahead[/b]!

We're trying to make [b][i]Plus Ultra: Legado[/i][/b] reach as many people as possible. 

Thus, we don't want to get stucked at 100%. In fact, we [b]already achieved 105%[/b] of the original pledge! We'd like to [b]surpass any limit[/b]—Actually, that's the game's motto, [b][i]PLUS ULTRA[/i][/b]. 

Therefore, we're moving forward. [b]Thank you very much[/b] to all of you who made this dream come true.
